title: Be brave, 1000 CFA francs

specs.Decoration: high relief, selective gold plating, crystal inserts

descriptionPlain: Description One ounce of high-quality silver Artistic combination of decorative techniques Symbol of strength, steadfastness and pride Lions, creatures endowed with a powerful spirit, have for centuries been considered symbols of royal dignity and masculine strength. These majestic predators are a source of inspiration for many communities, symbolizing fearlessness, honor and concern for family. A coin with the image of a lion is a unique gift in which strength, pride and elegance are intertwined. Discover the secret of royal heritage in every detail of this coin.
